title: Stable Semantic Collaboration Boundary
invariants: Collaboration semantic DTOs contain no Scratch target/runtime/backend identity.
NodeId is the primary semantic object identity; targetId is compatibility shadow only.
Remote node rename/destroy/transform mutation uses NGVGE command capabilities.
Project synchronization consumes the Project Lifecycle Host.
Extension synchronization consumes the Scratch Extension Host and not raw ExtensionManager authority.
Transport backends do not define Collaboration semantic identity or mutation authority.
Remaining block/asset/presence legacy paths are explicit compatibility debt and are not native semantic DTO fields.
nextDebtOwners: COL-G1 legacy targetId compatibility retirement gate
